A '''superior''' to [[Nira (Crystal guard)|Nira]]'s worked as a [[crystal guard]] for the [[Umbaran commando]]s<ref name="Scars" /> in [[3634 BBY]].<ref name="StoryDate" /> While guarding and transporting [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]]<ref name="Scars" /> the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]]<ref name="StoryDate" /> via a [[Train/Legends|train]] through the [[void forest]], the train got attacked by an [[Slybex|alpha slybex]] and was forced to a halt. She ordered her units to split into two squads and investigate the area. After the slybex attacked the squads, she panicked and fired [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shots towards the general vicinity of the chaos transpiring. The superior was the last one to scream before silence ensued. She was presumed [[Death/Legends|dead]] by Nira years later when recounting the story to her [[Squad One (Umbaran)|squad]]<ref name="Scars" /> in [[3629 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|5.4}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Nira's superior was first mentioned in<ref name="Scars" /> the short story "[[Trading Scars]]" written by [[Samantha Wallschlaeger]]<ref name="Tweet">{{Twitter|StillNotSam|status/898274643756421120|[[Samantha Wallschlaeger]]|quote=So, um... I'm really self-conscious about my prose and it took a lot of guts for me to write this little short story, so I'm proud I did it!|archivedate=20200814154941}}</ref> and published in the developer blog for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on [[August 17]], [[2017]].<ref name="Scars" />
